entries.label: Buildings
entries.description: Building shapes, roofs, storeys, doors, windows and how buildings stand together.
entries.reason: Kinds and looks are drafted from building shapes more than anything else, so notes about them are asked for first.

entries.label: Materials and colour
entries.description: What surfaces are made of and their colours, finishes and patterns.
entries.reason: A look's palette, materials and surfaces are drafted from what things are made of and their colours.

entries.label: Landscape and plants
entries.description: Ground, water, slopes, paths, trees, crops and other plants.
entries.reason: A world kind's ground, water and planted areas are drafted from what the land and its plants look like.

entries.label: Clothing
entries.description: What people wear and carry, described as garments, never as any person.
entries.reason: Inhabitants' outfits are drafted from garments, described as garments so that no note describes a person.

entries.label: Food and goods
entries.description: What is made, sold, eaten or stored there.
entries.reason: Shops, workplaces and their fixtures are drafted from what is made, sold and kept in a place.

entries.label: Vehicles and boats
entries.description: What moves people and goods, and where it stops.
entries.reason: Roads, berths and what moves on them are drafted from the vehicles and boats a place has.

entries.label: Scale
entries.description: How big, how many and how far, as rough figures for drafting, never as facts.
entries.reason: A kind's extent and counts are drafted from rough figures, which stay drafted figures and are never shown as facts.
